name: Abu Dhabi
summary: Capital of the United Arab Emirates, Abu Dhabi offers a quieter, more formal life than Dubai, with seaside skyscrapers, the imposing Sheikh Zayed Mosque and royal beaches on the Corniche and Saadiyat Island. It is one of the safest cities in the world according to various rankings, has zero income tax and has a remote work visa program designed for digital nomads. In exchange for that security and quality of life, the cost of living is high and the environment is more conservative than that of its neighbor Dubai.
